LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON pr.target_party_id = ca2.borrower_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, c.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset c
WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
      AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY c.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_exposure.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) - COALESCE(loan_exposure.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) loan_exposure ON g.guarantor_party_id = loan_exposure.borrower_party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, loan_exposure.total_loan_balance
HAVING SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > COALESCE(loan_exposure.total_loan_balance, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    g.guaranteed_amount AS 保证金额,
    g.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
        AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
  )
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id AS final_debtor_id,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = (
    SELECT borrower_party_id 
    FROM credit_agreement 
    WHERE agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
)
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE wp.issuer_institution_id = (
    SELECT institution_id 
    FROM credit_agreement 
    WHERE agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
)
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_type AS 担保方式,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS 担保合同笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS 被担保金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY 被担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 合同金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS 关联抵押物笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE eg.group_type = '关联客户型'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(h.carrying_amount - h.fair_value), 2) AS total_reversal_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS reversal_holding_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot h
JOIN wealth_product p ON h.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE h.carrying_amount > h.fair_value
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING SUM(h.carrying_amount - h.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY total_reversal_amount DESC, p.product_id ASC;

WITH overdue_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ds.overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (ds.principal_overdue_days > 0 OR ds.interest_overdue_days > 0)
      AND ds.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM delinquency_snapshot ds2 WHERE ds2.loan_id = ld.loan_id)
),
overdue_by_issuer AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ol.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM overdue_loans ol
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ol.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    obi.total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN overdue_by_issuer obi ON ma.issuer_party_id = obi.borrower_party_id 
                            AND wp.issuer_institution_id = obi.institution_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_lien_valid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY over_60_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.total_assets), 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.total_liabilities), 2) AS total_liabilities,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.net_assets), 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.annual_revenue), 2) AS annual_revenue
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.total_liabilities) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(fs.total_assets), 0), 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL AND fs.total_assets > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_assets_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.net_capital IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY net_capital_to_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    fs.annual_revenue AS 营业收入,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / SUM(fs.annual_revenue) OVER (), 6) AS 占比
FROM financial_snapshot fs
JOIN institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.annual_revenue
HAVING ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / SUM(fs.annual_revenue) OVER (), 6) > 0.15
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT 
    m.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(p.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot p
JOIN managed_asset m ON p.asset_id = m.asset_id
GROUP BY m.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS 本金合计
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_certificate_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_certificate_count DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.role_code AS 授权等级,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS 操作员人数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS 员工人数
FROM staff_assignment sa
JOIN staff_member sm ON sa.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.role_code
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY 操作员人数 DESC, 授权等级 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 笔数
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id AS 机构编号,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS 少计提总额,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS 净资产,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets, 6) AS 少计提占净资产的百分比
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
  AND p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY 少计提占净资产的百分比 DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id
HAVING ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / MAX(fs.annual_revenue), 6) > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS 风险加权资产,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS 贷款占风险加权资产百分比
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY 贷款占风险加权资产百分比 DESC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode AS 结算方式,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(pi.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC, 结算方式 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pr.record_id) AS exception_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pr.amount_value), 2) AS exception_amount,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(pr.amount_value) * 100.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS exception_to_capital_pct
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pr
JOIN institution i ON pr.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE pr.exception_flag = 1
  AND pr.event_date <= '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(pr.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY exception_to_capital_pct DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) AS 监管报送逾期记录数,
    ROUND(AVG(lb.principal_balance), 2) AS 台账平均金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS 拨备不足借据数,
    ROUND(SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
            THEN p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount
            ELSE 0
        END
    ), 2) AS 拨备缺口金额
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown l ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON l.loan_id = lb.loan_id
LEFT JOIN provision_snapshot p ON l.loan_id = p.loan_id
LEFT JOIN regulatory_submission_event_v3 r ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
    AND r.completion_date IS NULL
    AND r.deadline_date < '2026-06-30'
WHERE l.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 拨备缺口金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS 授信额度批复总数,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 治理异常记录金额,
    ROUND(AVG(gcr.ratio_value), 4) AS 平均观测比值
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 gcr ON i.institution_id = gcr.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 5
ORDER BY 治理异常记录金额 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非非关联方关系笔数
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN party p ON rtr.subject_id = p.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联目标主体数 DESC, 关系种类数 DESC, 客户名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS operational_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ore.record_id) AS operational_risk_valid_record_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON i.institution_id = ore.institution_id AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE a.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY operational_risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(pe.record_id) AS product_behavior_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
LEFT JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 pe ON i.institution_id = pe.institution_id AND pe.exception_flag = 1
WHERE i.institution_id IN (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM product_conduct_event_v3
    WHERE exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(record_id) >= 2
)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.record_id) AS valid_custody_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cr.exception_flag = 1 THEN cr.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 cr ON cr.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
    AND cr.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cr.event_code = 'CUSTODY'
WHERE ma.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN cr.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
